# Borrowing Policy

> Current as of 2026-10-10. Authority: [posted desk notice](../sources/desk-rules.txt); pilot choices: [decision log](../decisions.md).

## Current understanding

A tool is due **seven calendar days after checkout**. The desk writes the due date on the borrowing slip and reads it back to the borrower. The seven-day term is in the posted notice; reading the date aloud was added after the [29 September slip review](../meetings/2026-09-29-slip-clarity.md).

## Evidence and authority

The [desk notice](../sources/README.md) states the term and slip procedure. [D-01](../decisions.md#decision-log) retained the term for the pilot; [D-03](../decisions.md#decision-log) clarifies the verbal handoff. Neither the journal nor the reminder message is a source for a longer loan period.

## Related workflow

The [day-five reminder](reminder-workflow.md) is an optional notification, not an extension. At return, use the [check-in checklist](../../handbook/check-in/README.md). For damaged tools and branch-transfer questions, see [returns and exceptions](returns-and-exceptions.md).

## Open questions

The source does not specify cross-branch returns, renewal limits, or a damaged-tool fee. The [action register](../actions.md#open-actions) names owners for the first question; do not state the others as settled rules.
